problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 7 delivery trucks to unload at 7 different warehouse docks.

Each truck has a specific unloading sequence represented as pairs (Dock, Unloading time),
where each pair specifies the dock where unloading must occur and the time required to complete it.
The order of pairs indicates the strict sequence in which the unloading operations must be performed.

Truck details:
* Truck 1 requires the sequence: (Dock 3, 5) → (Dock 5, 6) → (Dock 6, 3) → (Dock 1, 6) → (Dock 4, 2) → (Dock 2, 10) → (Dock 7, 9)
* Truck 2 requires the sequence: (Dock 4, 8) → (Dock 1, 1) → (Dock 3, 9) → (Dock 6, 4) → (Dock 5, 6) → (Dock 7, 2) → (Dock 2, 9)
* Truck 3 requires the sequence: (Dock 7, 4) → (Dock 6, 10) → (Dock 2, 8) → (Dock 5, 6) → (Dock 3, 3) → (Dock 1, 5) → (Dock 4, 6)
* Truck 4 requires the sequence: (Dock 5, 9) → (Dock 2, 1) → (Dock 6, 2) → (Dock 4, 6) → (Dock 7, 5) → (Dock 1, 6) → (Dock 3, 1)
* Truck 5 requires the sequence: (Dock 1, 4) → (Dock 5, 9) → (Dock 7, 9) → (Dock 3, 6) → (Dock 6, 8) → (Dock 4, 2) → (Dock 2, 7)
* Truck 6 requires the sequence: (Dock 5, 3) → (Dock 7, 5) → (Dock 4, 4) → (Dock 1, 7) → (Dock 6, 5) → (Dock 2, 1) → (Dock 3, 1)
* Truck 7 requires the sequence: (Dock 7, 9) → (Dock 1, 5) → (Dock 3, 1) → (Dock 6, 4) → (Dock 5, 9) → (Dock 2, 3) → (Dock 4, 5)

Each unloading operation must proceed without interruption once it begins,
and each dock can only accommodate one truck at a time.
The objective is to determine the optimal sequence for all unloading operations at the docks
so that the total completion time for all trucks is minimized.
